faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi (AIIMS Delhi) for a project-based healthcare position located in Jhajjar, Haryana.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Project Research Scientist - III (Medical) under an ICMR funded project with the post code I-1666.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist - III (Medical) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS, BVSc, or BDS degree along with a Post Graduate Degree like MD, MVSc, MDS, MPH, or an MPH/PhD qualification, along with three years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Project Research Scientist - III (Medical) position is 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary as per ICMR rules and guidelines for project-based research staff.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit applications?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting applications via email is 13-10-2026. Candidates must ensure their submissions reach before this deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via email. Candidates are required to email their CV to [email protected] and fill out the Google form provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for AIIMS Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises shortlisting of candidates based on their qualifications and experience, followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will be placed at AIIMS Jhajjar in Haryana with the pincode 124105 under the specified research project.
